title: Kuka, one of the largest industrial robotics suppliers, says it is prioritizing US and Asia investments, as Europe's industrial companies are slow to adopt AI (Marilen Martin/Bloomberg)
summary: Marilen Martin / Bloomberg: Kuka, one of the largest industrial robotics suppliers, says it is prioritizing US and Asia investments, as Europe's industrial companies are slow to adopt AI — Many of Europe's industrial companies are too slow to adopt artificial intelligence, putting faster-moving global rivals in a position …
